integrity: Claim supported by a standalone conservative integral enclosure checker and proof of renewal identities. This is same-model evaluation, not independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: The sign result holds for N=7 through 12 and sufficiently weak positive common reset rates only. No priority or general-population threshold is established. Integral bounds assume exact Brownian dynamics and instantaneous common reset.
title: Three distinct weak-reset risk responses for simultaneous Brownian searchers
